tools.name: search_tracks
tools.description: Search US motocross tracks, off-road parks and training facilities by name, state or discipline. Returns name, city, state and the slug needed for get_track.

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: Full detail for one track by slug: address, coordinates, hours, amenities, operating status, upcoming events, and the track's published pricing where it has any. Pricing is the field most worth reading here; roughly half of listed tracks publish their rates and few other sources carry them.

tools.name: find_tracks_near
tools.description: Find tracks near a latitude and longitude, nearest first. Use for 'tracks near me' questions.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Motocross races and events: Supercross, Pro Motocross nationals, Arenacross, amateur races and practice days. Filter by state, month or type.

tools.name: list_season_schedules
tools.description: The season schedules Full Throttle keeps, one per series and season (2027 Supercross, 2027 Pro Motocross, 2026-27 Arenacross and others): each with its page, and the series site its dates were checked against and when.

tools.name: get_season_schedule
tools.description: Every race of one series' season in date order: dates, venue, city, state, ticket link and the race's page. Use for questions like 'when is Supercross in Detroit in 2027' or 'the 2027 Pro Motocross schedule'.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_season_schedule · Public sink: get_track.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_season_schedule · Public sink: get_track

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
